title: Machine Learning for Stellar Parameter Estimation from Spectra
abstract: We apply machine learning to estimate stellar atmospheric parameters such as effective temperature and surface gravity directly from low resolution spectra.

title: Deep Learning Stellar Spectra Analysis for Atmospheric Parameters
abstract: A deep learning model for stellar spectra that predicts atmospheric parameters including metallicity from survey spectra.

title: Estimating Stellar Atmospheric Parameters with Neural Networks and Spectra
abstract: Neural networks are trained on spectra to estimate stellar parameters for large spectroscopic surveys.

title: Machine Learning Applied to Stellar Spectra: A Review
abstract: This review summarizes machine learning methods for stellar spectra including parameter estimation and classification tasks.

title: Spectral Classification of Stars using Machine Learning
abstract: We classify stars into spectral types with machine learning classifiers trained on labeled spectra.

title: A Catalog of Stellar Spectra from the Sky Survey
abstract: We present a catalog of stellar spectra observed by the sky survey together with basic calibration details.

title: Machine Learning for Galaxy Morphology Classification
abstract: Machine learning methods classify galaxy morphology from imaging data in large surveys.

abstract: Deep neural networks predict stock market prices from financial time series.

abstract: A study of dating techniques for ancient pottery fragments.
